name: Bounded land worker improvements and resource caps
description: Non-base land queries on a synthetic 4x4 map, no bonuses/fungus/river/facilities/events. All rainfall/rockiness pairs; bare, farm, mine, road combinations and forest; two source-rule profiles and owned/unowned synthetic cap technology. Some rocky improvement states are editor-style inputs, not a claim they can be constructed directly. Solar, sea, fungus, special terrain and complete economy are outside this contract.
